prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black crop top with a white Adidas trefoil logo and shiny black pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04"].

message.content: {"matches":["P03"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P03 wears a black crop top with a visible white Adidas trefoil logo on the chest and shiny black pants. P01 wears a white crop top, P02 wears a black crop top but without a visible logo and has non-shiny pants, and P04 wears a white crop top. Only P03 fully matches the described appearance."}
